purpose: Open with a 14-second human-scale descent from surface command to abyssal machinery, state the central geopolitical and ecological question, then bridge directly into verified expedition evidence without a document carousel.
question: Who gets to control the minerals beneath the sea — and who decides what must remain untouched?
question_deck: A new strategic frontier is opening before the rules, science and consequences are settled.

shots.editorial_purpose: Begin with people and operational judgment so the deep-sea race is framed as a human decision before it becomes an industrial spectacle.
Widen from an individual operator to the shared ocean space whose legal status is at the center of the film.
Introduce the physical intervention and ecological stakes as the central question begins to resolve on screen.
Shift from extraction technology to competing national rulebooks, giving the geopolitical half of the question equal visual weight.
Land on the long-lived seabed consequence and dissolve into verified expedition evidence rather than another generic montage.
